purpose: Truthful, rights-aware source adapter registry for Feature Foundry Inspiration Vault and Asset Vault.

requirements: Preserve source URL, creator, license and provider metadata
Respect rate limits, attribution, moderation labels and cache rules
Provide a clipper or manual fallback when discovery APIs are unavailable
Never scrape private endpoints or invent an API
Revalidate provider status before shipping an adapter

hubs.name: Openverse
hubs.auth: No auth required for ordinary public search; authenticated clients may receive higher limits.
hubs.rate_limit: Provider-published limits apply; use backoff and local result caching.
hubs.attribution: Preserve creator, source, license and attribution fields.
hubs.rights_policy: Only import media whose license and downstream use fit the project.
hubs.moderation: Preserve sensitivity metadata and user filters.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache search metadata and thumbnails within provider guidance; content-address imported originals.
hubs.fallback: Open the source page or browser clipper when direct import is unavailable.

hubs.name: Wikimedia Commons
hubs.auth: Public MediaWiki APIs; authenticated editing is separate.
hubs.rate_limit: Use maxlag, continuation, descriptive User-Agent and respectful request pacing.
hubs.attribution: Preserve author, source page, license template, attribution and modification requirements.
hubs.rights_policy: Reuser is responsible for verifying each file license and any non-copyright restrictions.
hubs.moderation: Respect deletion, warning, and category metadata.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache metadata with revision identity; keep source URL and SHA-1 when provided.
hubs.fallback: Open the Commons file page when rights metadata is incomplete.

hubs.name: Flickr
hubs.auth: API key for public search; OAuth for private/user actions.
hubs.rate_limit: Honor per-key limits and paginate using documented fields.
hubs.attribution: Preserve owner, title, source URL and license.
hubs.rights_policy: Use license filters and do not infer reuse rights from visibility.
hubs.moderation: Respect safe-search and content-type filters.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache IDs/metadata and generate local derivatives only after import.
hubs.fallback: Browser clipper or manual URL import.

hubs.name: Unsplash
hubs.auth: Access key; OAuth for user actions. Demo and production modes differ.
hubs.rate_limit: Demo requests are limited; production access requires review.
hubs.attribution: Required Unsplash attribution and API usage links must remain visible.
hubs.rights_policy: Follow API terms; do not replicate the core Unsplash experience.
hubs.moderation: Use provider collections/search and respect takedowns.
hubs.cache_policy: Hotlink API image URLs where required; do not permanently proxy originals without permission.
hubs.fallback: Browser clipper or source-page import with rights review.

hubs.name: Pexels
hubs.auth: API key.
hubs.rate_limit: Default quotas apply; read response headers and request increases when needed.
hubs.attribution: Credit Pexels and photographers where required/recommended.
hubs.rights_policy: Use only under the Pexels API and content license terms.
hubs.moderation: Respect provider search and content controls.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache metadata and thumbnails; preserve source IDs and URLs.

hubs.name: Pixabay
hubs.auth: API key.
hubs.rate_limit: Documented per-minute limits; use 24-hour query caching and no mass download.
hubs.attribution: Show Pixabay source attribution in search experiences.
hubs.rights_policy: Follow Pixabay content license and API restrictions for each asset.
hubs.moderation: Use safe-search where appropriate.
hubs.cache_policy: Do not permanent-hotlink imported media; download approved assets into content-addressed storage.

hubs.name: Poly Haven
hubs.auth: No account required for public API; send a distinct User-Agent.
hubs.rate_limit: Respect service capacity and cache metadata/files.
hubs.attribution: Credit the API service as requested even though assets are CC0.
hubs.rights_policy: Assets are CC0; still preserve source and authorship metadata.
hubs.moderation: No special moderation model; validate files and previews.
hubs.cache_policy: Aggressively cache metadata and content-address imported files.

hubs.name: Sketchfab
hubs.auth: OAuth required for downloadable model access; public search has documented API routes.
hubs.rate_limit: Honor API quotas and temporary download URL expiry.
hubs.attribution: Preserve creator, model page and license attribution.
hubs.rights_policy: Only download models marked downloadable and comply with the selected license.
hubs.moderation: Respect mature-content filters and moderation state.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache metadata; immediately ingest authorized downloads into the vault before temporary URLs expire.
hubs.fallback: Open model page or manual GLB/glTF import.

hubs.name: Fab
hubs.auth: Epic/Fab account through official launcher or website.
hubs.rate_limit: No general-purpose public discovery/download API is assumed.
hubs.attribution: Preserve seller, listing, license tier and source URL.
hubs.rights_policy: Respect Fab Standard/CC/other listing-specific licenses and seat/tier terms.
hubs.moderation: Use provider maturity/content controls.
hubs.cache_policy: Import user-acquired files and preserve manifests; do not mirror marketplace content.
hubs.fallback: Manual import from an authorized Fab download.

hubs.name: Pinterest
hubs.auth: Approved Pinterest app and user OAuth for documented account/board operations.
hubs.rate_limit: Use current Pinterest API limits for approved endpoints.
hubs.attribution: Preserve Pin, creator/site and source-link attribution.
hubs.rights_policy: Do not treat Pinterest discovery as proof of reuse rights; follow the original source license.
hubs.moderation: Respect provider safety and board visibility.
hubs.cache_policy: Store references and thumbnails, not unlicensed source copies, until import is authorized.
hubs.fallback: Browser clipper is the default for arbitrary inspiration discovery.

hubs.name: DeviantArt
hubs.auth: OAuth 2.0; scopes vary by browse, collections and user actions.
hubs.rate_limit: Honor documented endpoint limits and pagination.
hubs.attribution: Preserve artist, deviation page and any display requirements.
hubs.rights_policy: Do not infer download/reuse rights; preserve artist terms and source flags.
hubs.moderation: Use mature-content filters and provider metadata.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache metadata/previews only as permitted; ingest originals only through authorized routes.

hubs.name: Tumblr
hubs.auth: API key for public endpoints; OAuth for user/private actions.
hubs.rate_limit: Documented consumer-key limits apply per hour/day.
hubs.attribution: Preserve blog, post URL, creator and reblog/source chain.
hubs.rights_policy: Respect copyright and post-specific permissions; visibility is not a reuse license.
hubs.moderation: Honor mature/content filters and deletion state.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache post metadata and imported user-authorized media; avoid mirroring entire blogs.

hubs.name: Bluesky / AT Protocol
hubs.auth: Many public AppView endpoints require no auth; user actions require authenticated sessions.
hubs.rate_limit: Honor endpoint and host limits; paginate with cursors.
hubs.attribution: Preserve DID/handle, post URI, source URL, alt text and embed metadata.
hubs.rights_policy: Visibility is not a reuse license; preserve source context and creator information.
hubs.moderation: Carry moderation labels and user preferences into previews.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache record IDs and blobs only when imported/allowed; support refresh by URI/CID.

hubs.name: X
hubs.auth: Official API enrollment and an applicable paid/access plan; oEmbed for supported public posts.
hubs.rate_limit: Plan- and endpoint-specific limits must be read dynamically.
hubs.attribution: Preserve author, post URL and source context.
hubs.rights_policy: Do not scrape private/internal endpoints or treat posts as reusable assets without permission.
hubs.moderation: Respect withheld/deleted/sensitive-content state.
hubs.cache_policy: Store references and provider IDs; import media only through authorized user workflows.
hubs.fallback: Browser clipper or oEmbed when API access is unavailable.

hubs.name: Reddit
hubs.auth: OAuth/application identity for API usage.
hubs.rate_limit: Honor documented rate-limit headers and listing pagination.
hubs.attribution: Preserve subreddit, post, author and original linked source.
hubs.rights_policy: Do not treat a post as a reusable-license grant; follow original source rights.
hubs.moderation: Respect NSFW/quarantine/removal/deletion state.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache IDs/metadata and approved imports; do not mirror communities.

hubs.name: Imgur
hubs.auth: Client ID for anonymous/public access; OAuth for account operations.
hubs.rate_limit: Read current API limits; revalidate developer portal status before release.
hubs.attribution: Preserve account/gallery/post URL and source context.
hubs.rights_policy: Do not assume upload or gallery visibility grants reuse rights.
hubs.moderation: Respect mature/removed content state.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache IDs/metadata; ingest only user-authorized content.
hubs.fallback: Browser clipper/manual import if API enrollment changes.

hubs.name: GIPHY
hubs.auth: API key; beta and production keys have different review and quotas.
hubs.rate_limit: Beta is limited; production access requires approval and analytics compliance.
hubs.attribution: Display Powered by GIPHY and provider attribution as required.
hubs.rights_policy: Use only through approved API terms; preserve creator/source metadata.
hubs.moderation: Use rating/content filters and moderation fields.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache IDs/metadata within terms; prefer MP4 for GIF playback and WebP for transparent stickers when supported.
hubs.fallback: Manual GIF/WebP/video import or another approved GIF source.

hubs.name: Tenor
hubs.auth: Existing approved clients only; new API clients are no longer accepted.
hubs.rate_limit: Existing-client quotas and cache guidance apply.
hubs.attribution: Retain Tenor attribution and content descriptions where required.
hubs.rights_policy: Do not build a new dependency on unavailable enrollment.
hubs.moderation: Respect content filters/ratings.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache results according to existing-client rules.
hubs.fallback: Use GIPHY, Openverse, Wikimedia, Imgur, Tumblr, or manual user import.

hubs.name: Are.na
hubs.auth: OAuth/current API credentials if the current v3 developer route is available.
hubs.rate_limit: Do not ship against deprecated v2 behavior; verify current v3 limits first.
hubs.attribution: Preserve channel, block, creator and source URL.
hubs.rights_policy: Treat blocks as references unless source rights permit import.
hubs.moderation: Respect private channels and account visibility.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache reference metadata; do not clone channels.
hubs.fallback: Browser clipper/manual import is the safe default.

hubs.name: ArtStation
hubs.auth: No verified general public developer API is assumed.
hubs.rate_limit: N/A for clipper; use ordinary user-driven browsing.
hubs.attribution: Preserve artist, project URL, original source and NoAI metadata.
hubs.rights_policy: Do not download beyond user-authorized browser access; preserve NoAI and artist terms.
hubs.moderation: Respect mature-content settings and project visibility.
hubs.cache_policy: Store reference cards and user-selected authorized imports only.

hubs.name: Behance
hubs.auth: No general Asset Vault discovery API is assumed.
hubs.rate_limit: N/A for clipper.
hubs.attribution: Preserve creator, project and source URL.
hubs.rights_policy: Treat as inspiration until rights are explicitly cleared.
hubs.moderation: Respect mature/project visibility.
hubs.cache_policy: Store references, not mirrored portfolios.

hubs.name: Dribbble
hubs.auth: Do not assume new public API enrollment without current verification.
hubs.rate_limit: N/A for clipper.
hubs.attribution: Preserve designer, shot and source URL.
hubs.rights_policy: Treat as reference unless licensed or creator-authorized.
hubs.moderation: Respect account/project visibility.
hubs.cache_policy: Store references, not bulk copies.

hubs.name: Instagram
hubs.auth: Official Meta APIs apply to supported user/business content; not a general public scraping API.
hubs.rate_limit: App-review and endpoint limits vary.
hubs.attribution: Preserve account, post and source URL.
hubs.rights_policy: Never scrape private endpoints or bypass login; import only user-authorized content.
hubs.moderation: Respect private accounts, age/sensitive content and deletion.
hubs.cache_policy: Cache provider IDs/metadata; do not mirror feeds.

hubs.name: Pixiv
hubs.auth: No verified stable public developer API is assumed.
hubs.rate_limit: N/A for clipper.
hubs.attribution: Preserve artist, work ID, page URL and tags.
hubs.rights_policy: Follow creator permissions and Pixiv terms; do not scrape internal APIs.
hubs.moderation: Respect age/mature and visibility controls.
hubs.cache_policy: Store references and user-authorized files only.

hubs.name: Cara
hubs.auth: No verified public developer API is assumed.
hubs.rate_limit: N/A for clipper.
hubs.attribution: Preserve creator and post URL.
hubs.rights_policy: Treat as reference unless creator-authorized/licensed.
hubs.moderation: Respect visibility and content controls.
hubs.cache_policy: Store references only by default.

hubs.name: Cosmos
hubs.auth: No verified general public API is assumed.
hubs.rate_limit: N/A for clipper.
hubs.attribution: Preserve collection/source URL and original source.
hubs.rights_policy: Treat as inspiration references unless rights are cleared.
hubs.moderation: Respect collection/account visibility.
hubs.cache_policy: Store reference metadata and thumbnails.

hubs.name: Savee
hubs.auth: No verified general public API is assumed.
hubs.rate_limit: N/A for clipper.
hubs.attribution: Preserve collection/source URL and original source.
hubs.rights_policy: Treat as inspiration references unless rights are cleared.
hubs.moderation: Respect account visibility.
hubs.cache_policy: Store references, not bulk mirrors.
